title: AlaDesign Landing Page Reveal
description: Preloader-to-hero landing page reveal driven by three parallel GSAP timelines with a custom 'hop' ease: a dark overlay counts 0 to 100 while masked overlay text steps through three lines, five portrait images rise and collapse their flex gap, the side images wipe away with clip-path as the center image scales up, then the overlay wipes upward and the giant hero name slides in word by word (SplitText). Plays automatically once on page load, about 7 seconds total.

images.desc: close-up fashion portrait of a model with crystal gems across the brow, chunky gold necklace and earrings, orange trench coat, teal-blue backdrop
editorial fashion shot of a model in an orange belted trench coat holding a white calla lily, teal-blue backdrop
editorial fashion shot of a model in a voluminous red ball gown skirt with sharp-shouldered black jacket and gold statement jewelry, teal-blue backdrop
profile portrait of a model in an orange trench coat with gold choker, crystal gems on her face, teal-blue backdrop
full-body fashion shot of a model striding in a long orange coat over black turtleneck and trousers, holding an orange clutch, teal-blue backdrop

intent.useWhen: Úsalo para la entrada de una landing de moda o portfolio donde un preloader con contador desemboca en un nombre gigante y foto editorial.
